name: bld4_mantel_equality_complete_bipartite
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.CliqueFree 3) (he : 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2) : ∃ s : Finset V, 2 * s.card = Fintype.card V ∧ ∀ x y : V, G.Adj x y ↔ (x ∈ s ↔ y ∉ s)
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.CliqueFree 3) (he : 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2), ∃ s : Finset V, 2 * s.card = Fintype.card V ∧ ∀ x y : V, G.Adj x y ↔ (x ∈ s ↔ y ∉ s)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_mantel_equality_regular and Mathlib2.bld3_mantel_equality_same_neighbors: if V is empty take s = ∅; otherwise fix v and let s = G.neighborFinset v, of size n/2 by bld2_mantel_equality_regular. Two vertices of s are non-adjacent (triangle-free); a vertex y ∉ s is non-adjacent to v so by bld3_mantel_equality_same_neighbors it has the same neighbours as v, i.e. it is adjacent exactly to the vertices of s; this gives Adj x y ↔ (x ∈ s ↔ y ∉ s) in all four cases.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], G.CliqueFree 3 → 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2 → ∃ s, 2 * s.card = Fintype.card V ∧ ∀ (x y : V), G.Adj x y ↔ (x ∈ s ↔ y ∉ s)
